title: The New Covenant

questions.question: "At that time, declares the Lord, I will be the God of all the clans of Israel, and they shall be my..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:1 (ESV): "At that time, declares the Lord, I will be the God of all the clans of Israel, and they shall be my people."

questions.question: "The Lord appeared to him from far away. I have loved you with an... love; therefore I have continued my faithfulness to you."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:3 (ESV): "I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have continued my faithfulness to you."

questions.question: "Again I will build you, and you shall be built, O virgin Israel! Again you shall adorn yourself with..., and shall go forth in the dance of the merrymakers."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:4 (ESV): "Again you shall adorn yourself with tambourines and shall go forth in the dance of the merrymakers."

questions.question: "They shall come and sing aloud on the height of Zion, and they shall be radiant over the goodness of the Lord...; their life shall be like a watered..., and they shall languish no more."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:12 (ESV): "their life shall be like a watered garden, and they shall languish no more."

questions.question: "Thus says the Lord: 'A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping... is weeping for her children; she refuses to be comforted... because they are no more.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:15 (ESV): "Rachel is weeping for her children; she refuses to be comforted for her children, because they are no more."

questions.question: Who did the Lord say he heard grieving, saying, "You have disciplined me, and I was disciplined, like an untrained calf; bring me back that I may be restored"?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:18 (ESV): "I have heard Ephraim grieving, 'You have disciplined me, and I was disciplined, like an untrained calf...'"

questions.question: The Lord says of Ephraim: "Is Ephraim my dear... ? Is he my darling... ? For as often as I speak against him, I do remember him still."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:20 (ESV): "Is Ephraim my dear son? Is he my darling child?"

questions.question: "How long will you waver, O faithless daughter? For the Lord has created a new thing on the earth: a woman encircles a..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:22 (ESV): "a woman encircles a man." (Note that interpretations of this vary widely).

questions.question: "In those days they shall no longer say: 'The fathers have eaten sour..., and the children's teeth are set on edge.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:29 (ESV): "The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge."

questions.question: "But everyone shall die for his own iniquity. Each man who eats sour grapes, his own teeth shall be set on edge." What doctrine does this emphasize?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:30 (ESV): "But everyone shall die for his own iniquity." This shifts from the consequence falling on descendants to individual accountability.

questions.question: "Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new... with the house of Israel and the house of Judah,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:31 (ESV): "when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and the house of Judah,"

questions.question: How will the new covenant be different from the covenant made with their fathers when the Lord brought them out of Egypt?
options: "I will put my law within them, and I will write it on their hearts."
"I will write it on tablets of gold."
"I will read it from the heavens daily."
questions.correctAnswer: "I will put my law within them, and I will write it on their hearts."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:33 (ESV): "For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel... I will put my law within them, and I will write it on their hearts."

questions.question: "And no longer shall each one teach his neighbor and each his brother, saying, 'Know the Lord,' for they shall all... me, from the least of them to the greatest,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:34 (ESV): "for they shall all know me, from the least of them to the greatest, declares the Lord."

questions.question: "...For I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin... "
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:34 (ESV): "For I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more."

questions.question: The Lord says: "If this fixed order [the sun, moon, and stars] departs from before me, declares the Lord, then shall the offspring of... also cease from being a nation before me forever."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 31:36 (ESV): "then shall the offspring of Israel also cease from being a nation before me forever."

key_verse_text: "Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and the house of Judah... I will put my law within them, and I will write it on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they shall be my people."
